statement: Incidence blow-up induction gives counterexamples for every 1<=i<n/2.
depends_on: Cycles C.1f; regular two-generator Rees presentation; blow-up formula
notes: No embedding or dimension gap found.

statement: Scalar multiplication maps factoring through products of Jacobians form an ideal; generator one is equivalent to an actual direct summand.
notes: Includes duality products and exact isogeny divisibility.

statement: For a g-dimensional abelian variety over any algebraically closed field the scalar obstruction divides (2g-1)!.
depends_on: Scavia-Suzuki2025 Proposition3.4 equations3.1-3.3; Poincare line bundle
notes: All characteristics including 2 and 3; actual homomorphism factorization.

statement: For g<=3 the scalar obstruction divides gcd((2g-1)!,delta(A)) with delta(A)=gcd chi(L).
notes: Different polarizations may be chosen for each bad prime; Bezout gives one exact retraction.

statement: Finite NS Euler-polynomial computation gives sufficient tests; same-dimensional prime-to-ell principalization is impossible if ell divides delta(A).
depends_on: C.4j; pullback of a principal polarization
notes: This limitation does not rule out retractions through higher-dimensional Jacobians.

statement: For a complex NS-rank-one surface of type(1,d) with End=Z the divisor-product subring yields exactly gcd(6,d) multiples of the identity.
notes: No assertion that all integral curves are divisor products.

statement: Specializing the complete torsion Albanese relation repairs the characteristic-p proof.
depends_on: Bloch1979 Propositions3.5/3.8/3.9 and Theorem4.2; finite-field CH0 torsion
